Order:

The instant Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the Petitioners/Accused Nos.1 and 2, seeking to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.589 of 2018 on the file of the Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Banaganapalli for the offences under Sections 420 and 506 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: When the matter is taken up for hearing, Sri P.Nagendra Reddy, learned counsel for the Petitioners would submit that, without causing any prejudice to the rights and contentions of the Petitioners, the Petitioners may be permitted to withdraw the petition.

3. Ms.D.Prasanna Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor and Sri Bolla Venkata Rama Rao,
learned counsel for Respondent No.2 are in attendance.
4. In that view of the matter, the criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
However, the Petitioners are at liberty to raise all their contentions before the trial Court.

Pending applications, if any, shall stand closed.
